title.zh: Anthropic秘密游说国会：模型须面临超10亿美元损失或50人伤亡风险，政府才能叫停
title.en: Anthropic秘密游说国会：模型须面临超10亿美元损失或50人伤亡风险，政府才能叫停

current_state.zh: Anthropic is privately lobbying US lawmakers on a draft frontier AI safety bill that would permit government intervention only when a model poses imminent risk of over $1 billion in damages or 50+ deaths or serious injuries, limited to bioweapon, loss-of-control, and cyberattack scenarios, with independent third-party evaluations and court approval required.
